value: THE PROOF KILLED THE FIRST DESIGN, on its first firing. The draft tolerated an unlinked leading PREFIX as 'prehistory', to carry the 73 trails that predated links — it read as the honest way to avoid redding the whole corpus on adoption day. The falsifier tooth showed it was the opposite: an overwrite that drops every link is indistinguishable from a legacy trail, and a total overwrite is exactly the destroy-the-whole-history shape this ticket's trouble described. THE GENERAL SHAPE, worth carrying past this ticket: A TOLERANCE IS A FORGER'S COSTUME WHENEVER THE FORGER CAN PRODUCE THE THING BEING TOLERATED. A compatibility clause is not neutral — it is a stated description of what the gate will wave through, and anything that can be shaped to match it walks. The fix was to remove the clause rather than narrow it: adopt the legacy trails once, and say plainly what a retro-minted link claims (content as of adoption, not as of sealing) instead of letting it wear a seal-time link's authority.
